name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.60 / build 61 unifies app alerts and popup dialogs with the logout mint/teal style. Staff home-service cancellations create private in-app notices and move the record to History; notification-opened History returns to Notifications with one Back. Includes the previous single-service/active-booking and three-patient daily rules. Matching cancellation server update is deployed. Existing development signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval.
